title: RBI builds second secure data centre in Bhubaneswar, Odisha
summary: RBI built its 2nd greenfield high-security Tier-IV data centre in Bhubaneswar, Odisha for currency management and core payments (Primary DC: Kharghar, Navi Mumbai).
